style: A plain, seamless WHITE void with soft, even, shadowless studio lighting - no floor line, no props, no set dressing. REF 1 stands centered in frame for the full 10 seconds, performing one continuous, slow, steady turn under a static camera that never moves, pans or zooms. No dialogue, no other performers.
cuts: REF 1 stands facing the camera directly, full body visible from head to toe, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at their sides. The pose is already settled at the start of the cut and holds completely still, square-on to camera, for the full 3 seconds.

REF 1 begins turning smoothly to their own left, completing the rotation to a full side-on left-profile view within the first half of this cut, full body still visible head to toe. They hold that profile position, still and level, for the remainder of the cut.

REF 1 continues the same steady rotation, completing the turn to face directly away from camera - a full back view, full body visible head to toe - within the first half of this cut, then holds that position still for the remainder.

REF 1 continues the same steady rotation, completing the turn to a full side-on right-profile view, full body visible head to toe, within the first half of this cut, then holds that position still for the remainder.

REF 1 completes the rotation back to face the camera directly, full body visible, within the first half of this cut. Simultaneously, the camera
performs a slow push-in that ends framed as a close-up on the head and shoulders only, face square to camera. Both the turn and the push-in finish by the midpoint of the cut; the final close-up composition holds completely
still for the remainder.
